Definition: a willow (as growing in overflowed places)
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsaphtsâphâh is the word for a willow (as growing in overflowed places). It appears once, in Ezekiel 17:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsaphtsâphâh is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
